en.s: The Battle of Pharsalus was the decisive battle of Caesar's Civil War fought on 9 August 48 BC near Pharsalus in Central Greece. Julius Caesar and his allies formed up opposite the army of the Roman Republic under the command of Pompey. Pompey had the backing of a majority of Roman senators and his army significantly outnumbered the veteran Caesarian legions.

zh.s: 法萨卢斯战役于公元前48年8月9日在希腊中部法萨卢斯附近爆发，是凯撒内战的决定性战役。尤利乌斯·恺撒及其盟友列阵迎战罗马共和国军队，后者由庞培指挥。庞培得到大多数罗马元老的支持，所率军队人数也远超经验丰富的恺撒军团。

en.s: The Battle of Adrianople, also known as Battle of Hadrianopolis, was fought between the Eastern Roman army led by the Roman emperor Valens and Gothic rebels (largely Thervings as well as Greutungs, non-Gothic Alans, and various local rebels), led by Fritigern. The battle took place on 9 August 378 in the vicinity of Adrianople, in the Roman province of Thracia (modern Edirne in European Turkey).

zh.s: 阿德里安堡战役又称哈德良堡战役，于378年8月9日在罗马帝国色雷斯行省阿德里安堡附近（今土耳其欧洲部分的埃迪尔内）爆发。交战双方是由罗马皇帝瓦伦斯率领的东罗马军队，以及弗里提根率领的哥特起义军；后者主要由特尔温吉人、格勒通吉人、非哥特裔阿兰人和各地叛军组成。

en.s: The Battle of the Morcuera, was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place in the Hoz de la Morcuera between the municipalities of Foncea and Bugedo nearby the city of Miranda de Ebro on 9 August, 865. The battle was fought between the combined Christian troops of the Kingdom of Castile and the Kingdom of Asturias under Rodrigo of Castile and the UmayyadMuslim forces of the Emirate of Cordoba under Muhammad I of Córdoba.

zh.s: 莫尔库埃拉战役于865年8月9日在西班牙收复失地运动期间发生，战场位于莫尔库埃拉山口，介于丰塞亚和布格多两市镇之间，靠近米兰达-德埃布罗。交战双方是卡斯蒂利亚王国的罗德里戈和阿斯图里亚斯王国率领的基督教联军，以及科尔多瓦埃米尔国的倭马亚穆斯林军队，由科尔多瓦的穆罕默德一世统率。

en.s: The Battle of Niså (Slaget ved Niså) was a naval battle fought on 9 August 1062 between the forces of Norwegian king Harald Hardrada and king Sweyn II of Denmark. Harald had claimed the Danish throne since 1047, and had launched raids into Denmark ever since. With his invasion in 1062, he wanted to decisively defeat the Danes, and thus finally be able to conquer Denmark. The battle was won clearly by the Norwegians, but since many Danes managed to escape, including Sweyn, it proved indecisive in Harald's attempt to conquer Denmark.

zh.s: 尼瑟海战（挪威语：Slaget ved Niså）于1062年8月9日爆发，是挪威国王哈拉尔·哈德拉达与丹麦国王斯文二世之间的一场海战。哈拉尔自1047年以来一直觊觎丹麦王位，并不断袭扰丹麦。1062年，他发动入侵，意在彻底击败丹麦人，进而征服丹麦。挪威军队取得明显胜利，但许多丹麦人包括斯文二世成功逃脱，因此哈拉尔征服丹麦的企图仍未实现。

en.s: The Battle of Fyrileiv was the first battle in the Norwegian Civil War. It was fought between the co-kings Magnus Sigurdsson and Harald Gille at the farm Fyrileiv in Ranrike (now Färlev in Stågenäs lordship in Bohuslen) on 9 August 1134. The battle is mentioned in Magnus Blindes and Harald Gilles saga in Snorre's Heimskringla, and in Fagrskinna.

zh.s: 菲里莱夫战役是挪威内战的首场战斗，于1134年8月9日在兰里克的菲里莱夫农场爆发，交战双方是共同执政的国王马格努斯·西古德松和哈拉尔·吉勒。该农场位于现今布胡斯兰省斯托根奈斯地区的法勒夫。此战见于斯诺里《海姆斯克林格拉》中的《盲人马格努斯与哈拉尔·吉勒萨迦》，以及《法格尔斯金纳》。

en.t: Construction of the campanile of the Cathedral of Pisa (now known as the Leaning Tower of Pisa) begins; it will take two centuries to complete
en.s: Pisa Cathedral (Italian: Duomo di Pisa), officially the Primatial Metropolitan Cathedral of the Assumption of Mary (Cattedrale Metropolitana Primaziale di Santa Maria Assunta), is a medieval Catholic cathedral dedicated to the Assumption of the Virgin Mary, in the Piazza dei Miracoli in Pisa, Italy, the oldest of the three structures in the plaza followed by the Pisa Baptistry and the Campanile known as the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

zh.t: 比萨大教堂钟楼（今称比萨斜塔）开始兴建；工程历时两个世纪才完成
zh.s: 比萨大教堂（意大利语：Duomo di Pisa；正式名称为圣母升天都主教座堂）是意大利比萨奇迹广场上的一座中世纪天主教大教堂，供奉圣母升天。它是广场上三座建筑中最古老的一座，其后还有比萨洗礼堂，以及被称为比萨斜塔的钟楼。

en.s: The siege of al-Shughur took place in August 1188 between the Ayyubid Sultanate led by Saladin and the Principality of Antioch, who held modern-day Jisr al-Shughur. Saladin captured the two forts, Shughr-Bakas, lying there.

en.s: The Battle of Calcinato was a military engagement during the wars between the Guelphs and Ghibellines. It took place on 9 August 1201 near Calcinato, southeast of Brescia. The Ghibelline forces won.

zh.s: 卡尔奇纳托战役于1201年8月9日在布雷西亚东南、卡尔奇纳托附近发生，是圭尔夫派与吉伯林派战争期间的一次军事交战。吉伯林派军队获胜。

en.t: Quilon, the first Indian Christian Diocese, is erected by Pope John XXII; the French-born Jordanus is appointed the first Bishop
en.s: Christianity is India's third-largest religion with 28 million adherents, who make up 2.3 percent of the population, according to the 2011 census. Nearly two-thirds (65 percent) of India's Christians are found in South India, Goa and Mumbai (Bombay). Christianity is the major religion in parts of Northeast India, specifically in Nagaland, Mizoram and Meghalaya. Christians are also a significant plurality in Manipur.

zh.t: 教宗若望二十二世设立印度首个基督教教区奎隆教区，并任命法国出生的乔丹努斯为首任主教
zh.s: 根据2011年人口普查，基督教是印度第三大宗教，信徒约2,800万，占总人口的2.3%。印度基督徒近三分之二（65%）居住在南印度、果阿和孟买（孟买旧称Bombay）。基督教是印度东北部部分地区的主要宗教，尤其是在那加兰邦、米佐拉姆邦和梅加拉亚邦；在曼尼普尔邦，基督徒也构成重要的相对多数群体。

en.s: The Battle of Modon, also known as the Second Battle of Lepanto, took place in August 1500 during the war of 1499–1503 between the Ottoman Empire and the Republic of Venice. The Ottomans, who had won the Battle of Zonchio (First Battle of Lepanto / Battle of Sapienza) the previous year, were again victorious under Admiral Kemal Reis.

en.s: The Battle of Brobacka was a battle fought in Alingsås between Sweden and Denmark, on August 9, 1566. The Swedish army under command of Charles de Mornay successfully managed to ambush Daniel Rantzau and his Danish army on their arrival back from their looting train in Västergötland, southwest of Sweden.

zh.s: 布罗巴卡战役于1566年8月9日在瑞典阿灵索斯发生，交战双方为瑞典和丹麦。查理·德·莫尔奈指挥的瑞典军队成功伏击了丹尼尔·兰茨劳及其丹麦军队；后者刚结束对瑞典西南部韦斯特约特兰地区的劫掠，正在返程。

en.s: The Battle of Çıldır was fought on 9 August 1578 during the Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590). The battle took place in Çıldır, about 150 km southwest of Tiflis, the capital of the Georgian Kingdom of Kartli.

zh.s: 奇尔迪尔战役于1578年8月9日爆发，属于奥斯曼—萨法维战争（1578–1590年）的一部分。战场位于奇尔迪尔，距格鲁吉亚卡尔特利王国首都第比利斯西南约150公里。

en.s: Battle of Herat took place on August 9, 1598, between the Shaybanid Khanate and the Safavid Empire for Khorasan and Balkh. The battle resulted in the complete defeat of the Uzbeks and Safavid Empire fully restored its power in Khorasan and got back the region.

zh.s: 赫拉特战役于1598年8月9日爆发，交战双方是为争夺呼罗珊和巴尔赫而战的昔班尼汗国与萨法维王朝。乌兹别克人遭到彻底击败，萨法维王朝完全恢复了对呼罗珊的控制并收复该地区。

en.t: The First Anglo-Powhatan War begins in colonial Virginia
en.s: The Anglo–Powhatan Wars were three wars fought between settlers of the Colony of Virginia and the Powhatan Confederacy of Tsenacommacah in the early 17th century. The first war started in 1609 and ended in a peace settlement in 1614. The second war lasted from 1622 to 1632. The third war lasted from 1644 until 1646 and ended when Opechancanough was captured and killed.

zh.t: 第一次英—波瓦坦战争在殖民地弗吉尼亚爆发
zh.s: 17世纪初，弗吉尼亚殖民地定居者与特森纳科马卡的波瓦坦联盟之间发生了三场英—波瓦坦战争。第一次战争于1609年开始，1614年以和平协议结束。第二次战争持续于1622年至1632年。第三次战争从1644年持续到1646年，奥佩昌卡诺被俘并遭杀害后战争结束。

en.s: The Battle of Wittenweiher took place on August 9, 1638, near the village of Wittenweiher today: Wittenweier, a district of Schwanau, Baden-Württemberg, which was completely destroyed in the course of the battle.

zh.s: 维滕魏尔战役于1638年8月9日在维滕魏尔村附近发生。该村现称维滕魏尔，是巴登-符腾堡州施万瑙市镇的一个区，在战斗中被彻底摧毁。

en.s: The siege of Arras took place from 22 June to 9 August 1640, during the Franco-Spanish War that had begun in 1635, a connected conflict of the Thirty Years' War. A French army besieged the Spanish-held town of Arras, capital of the province of Artois, then part of the Spanish Netherlands, which surrendered after holding out for 48 days.

zh.s: 阿拉斯围城战发生于1640年6月22日至8月9日，期间正值1635年开始的法西战争；这场冲突也与三十年战争有关。法军围攻由西班牙控制的阿拉斯城。阿拉斯是阿图瓦省的首府，当时属于西属尼德兰。守军坚守48天后，阿拉斯投降。

en.s: The Battle of Freiburg, also called the Three Day Battle, took place on 3, 5 and 9 August 1644 as part of the Thirty Years' War. The Bavarian army under Franz von Mercy captured the city of Freiburg on 28 July after a siege of 5 weeks. The French army under Louis II de Bourbon, Duc d'Enghien and marshal Henri de la Tour d'Auvergne, Vicomte de Turenne, tried to recapture it at three separate days. The battle was interrupted due to heavy rain.

zh.s: 弗赖堡战役又称“三日战役”，于1644年8月3日、5日和9日爆发，属于三十年战争的一部分。巴伐利亚军队围城五周后，于7月28日攻占弗赖堡。法国军队由昂吉安公爵路易二世·德·波旁和元帅亨利·德·拉图尔·奥弗涅（蒂雷纳子爵）率领，连续三天试图夺回该城。战斗因暴雨而中断。

en.s: The Chyhyryn campaign or Chigirin campaign was an unsuccessful siege conducted by the Russian-Cossack forces in order to oust Petro Doroshenko from power, along with Ottoman–Crimean forces on his side.

en.s: The siege of Fort William Henry (3–9 August 1757, French: Bataille de Fort William Henry) was conducted by a French and Indian force led by Louis-Joseph de Montcalm against the British-held Fort William Henry. This fort, located at the southern end of Lake George, on the frontier between the British Province of New York and the French Province of Canada, was garrisoned by a poorly supported force of British regulars and provincial militia led by Lieutenant Colonel George Monro.

zh.s: 威廉·亨利堡围城战（1757年8月3日至9日；法语：Bataille de Fort William Henry）由路易-约瑟夫·德·蒙卡尔姆率领的法军及其印第安盟军发动，目标是英军控制的威廉·亨利堡。堡垒位于乔治湖以南，处在英属纽约省与法属加拿大省的边界地带。堡内守军由乔治·蒙罗中校率领，包括支援不足的英军正规部队和殖民地民兵。

en.s: The siege of Fort Loudoun was an engagement during the Anglo-Cherokee War fought from February 1760 to August 1760 between the warriors of the Cherokee led by Ostenaco and the garrison of Fort Loudoun (in what is now Tennessee) composed of British and colonial soldiers commanded by Captain Paul Demeré.

zh.s: 劳登堡围城战是英切洛基战争期间的一场交战。战争从1760年2月持续到8月，交战双方是奥斯特纳科率领的切洛基战士，以及由保罗·德梅雷上尉指挥的劳登堡守军。该堡垒位于今田纳西州，守军由英国士兵和殖民地士兵组成。

en.s: The action of 9 August 1780 was a naval engagement during the American Revolutionary War and a part of the Anglo-French War (1778–1783) in which a Spanish fleet and French fleet, led by Admiral Luis de Córdova y Córdova, encountered a large British convoy. The Franco-Spanish force captured almost all the merchant vessels in the convoy, which dealt a severe blow to the commerce of Great Britain.

zh.s: 1780年8月9日的海战发生在美国独立战争期间，也是1778年至1783年英法战争的一部分。路易斯·德·科尔多瓦·科尔多瓦海军上将率领的西班牙和法国舰队遭遇了一支规模庞大的英国船队。法西联军俘获了船队中几乎所有商船，严重打击了英国的商业贸易。

en.s: In the Battle of Zújar of the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars, on 9 August 1811 an Imperial French division from Nicolas Soult's army attacked a Spanish division belonging to Manuel Alberto Freire de Andrade y Armijo's Army of Murcia. The French division, led by Nicolas Godinot, defeated Joseph O'Donnell's Spanish division with heavy losses. Zújar is located on Route 323, 13 kilometres (8 mi) northwest of Baza, Granada in Spain. Spanish armies under Freire and Joaquín Blake y Joyes threatened the French grip on the south of Spain during the summer of 1811.

zh.s: 苏哈尔战役于1811年8月9日爆发，属于半岛战争（拿破仑战争的一部分）。尼古拉·苏尔特军团的一支法兰西帝国师进攻曼努埃尔·阿尔韦托·弗雷雷·德·安德拉德·阿尔米霍穆尔西亚军团中的一支西班牙师。尼古拉·戈迪诺率领法军，击败了约瑟夫·奥唐奈指挥的西班牙师，造成西班牙军重大损失。苏哈尔位于西班牙格拉纳达省巴萨西北13公里（8英里）的323号公路旁。1811年夏季，弗雷雷和华金·布莱克·霍伊斯率领的西班牙军队威胁法国对西班牙南部的控制。

en.s: The Battle of Maguaga (also known as the Battle of Monguagon or the Battle of the Oakwoods) was a small battle between British troops, Canadian militia and Tecumseh's natives and a larger force of American troops near the Wyandot village of Maguaga in what is now the city of Riverview, Michigan.

zh.s: 马瓜加战役又称蒙瓜贡战役或橡树林战役，是一场小规模战斗，交战双方为英国军队、加拿大民兵和特库姆塞麾下的原住民战士，以及人数更多的美国军队。战斗发生在密歇根州里弗维尤市今怀恩多特村附近。

en.s: The Treaty of Fort Jackson (also known as the Treaty with the Creeks, 1814) was signed on August 9, 1814 at Fort Jackson near Wetumpka, Alabama following the defeat of the Red Stick (Upper Creek) resistance by United States allied forces at the Battle of Horseshoe Bend. It occurred on the banks of the Tallapoosa River near the present city of Alexander City, Alabama. The U.S. force, led by General Andrew Jackson, consisted mainly of the West Tennessee Militia and 39th United States Infantry, allied with several groups of Cherokee and Lower Creek friendly to the American side.

zh.s: 杰克逊堡条约又称《与克里克人的条约（1814年）》，于1814年8月9日在阿拉巴马州韦图姆普卡附近的杰克逊堡签署。此前，美国及其盟友在马蹄湾战役中击败了红棍派（上克里克人）抵抗力量。条约签署地点位于塔拉普萨河岸，靠近现今阿拉巴马州亚历山大城。安德鲁·杰克逊将军率领的美军主要由西田纳西民兵和美国陆军第39步兵团组成，并与几个支持美国的切罗基族和下克里克族群结盟。

en.s: The Battle of Langnes, or the Battle of Langnes Entrenchment, was fought between Norway and Sweden as a part of the Swedish-Norwegian War of 1814. The battle, even as it ended inconclusively, served as a tactical victory to the Norwegians since they now could avoid an unconditional surrender to the Swedish.

zh.s: 朗内斯战役又称朗内斯壕沟战役，是1814年瑞典—挪威战争期间挪威与瑞典之间的一场战斗。战斗虽未分胜负，却在战术上有利于挪威，使挪威得以避免无条件投降。

en.s: The Battle of Kejiwan took place on 9 August 1826 during the Java War between rebel forces under Prince Diponegoro and a flying column of Dutch colonial and Mangkunegaran troops. The flying column, which had been pursuing Diponegoro during his march north, was defeated in a pitched battle, allowing Diponegoro to continue his march.

zh.s: 克吉万战役于1826年8月9日爆发，属于爪哇战争的一部分，交战双方是迪波尼哥罗亲王率领的叛军和荷兰殖民军及芒昆内加兰军队组成的机动纵队。该纵队此前一直在迪波尼哥罗向北行军时追击他，但在正面交战中被击败，使迪波尼哥罗得以继续行军。

en.t: Louis Philippe becomes the king of the French following abdication of Charles X
en.s: Louis Philippe I (6 October 1773 – 26 August 1850), nicknamed the Citizen King, was King of the French from 1830 to 1848, the penultimate monarch of France, the last French monarch to bear the title "King", and the only French monarch to descend from the Orléans branch of the Bourbon family. He abdicated from his throne during the French Revolution of 1848, which led to the foundation of the French Second Republic.

zh.t: 查理十世退位后，路易-菲利普成为法国国王
zh.s: 路易-菲利普一世（1773年10月6日—1850年8月26日）绰号“公民国王”，1830年至1848年在位，是法国倒数第二位君主，也是最后一位称“国王”的法国君主；他还是唯一一位出身波旁王朝奥尔良支系的法国君主。1848年法国革命期间，他退位，随后法兰西第二共和国成立。

en.s: The Webster–Ashburton Treaty was a treaty that resolved several border issues between the United States and the British North American colonies (the region that later became the Dominion of Canada). Negotiated in the US federal capital city of Washington, DC, it was signed August 9, 1842, under the new administration of US president John Tyler, who as the former vice president, had just recently succeeded and became chief executive upon the unexpected death of his running mate and predecessor, William Henry Harrison, who had only served a single month in office.

zh.t: 韦伯斯特—阿什伯顿条约
zh.s: 韦伯斯特—阿什伯顿条约解决了美国与英属北美殖民地之间的若干边界争端；该地区后来成为加拿大自治领。条约在美国首都华盛顿特区谈判，并于1842年8月9日签署。当时美国总统约翰·泰勒刚就任；他此前是副总统，在竞选搭档、前任总统威廉·亨利·哈里森意外去世后接任。哈里森仅在任一个月。

en.s: The Battle of Temesvár (now Timişoara, in Romania) was a battle in the Hungarian Revolution of 1848, fought on 9 August 1849 between the Austrian Empire and Hungarian Revolutionary Army supplemented by Polish volunteers. The Austrians were led by Julius Jacob von Haynau, while the Hungarians were led by Józef Bem who arrived at the eleventh hour from Transylvania. The Austrians were victorious. The Hungarians had only their southern division here, and although they had slightly more men than the Austrians, they lacked experience and good equipment.

zh.s: 特梅什瓦尔战役（今罗马尼亚蒂米什瓦拉）于1849年8月9日爆发，是匈牙利革命期间奥地利帝国与匈牙利革命军之间的一场战斗；匈牙利军队还有波兰志愿兵增援。奥军由尤利乌斯·雅各布·冯·海瑙率领，匈军由约瑟夫·贝姆指挥；贝姆在最后关头从特兰西瓦尼亚赶到。奥地利军队获胜。匈牙利军队在当地只有南方师，虽然人数略多于奥军，但缺乏经验和良好装备。

en.s: The siege of Temesvár (today: Timișoara, Romania) was a siege during the Hungarian Revolution of 1848 between the Austrian Empire and Hungarian Revolutionary Army. The Hungarians unsuccessfully tried to capture the Timișoara Fortress. The siege ended with the Battle of Temesvár.

en.t: American Transcendentalist philosopher Henry David Thoreau publishes his memoir Walden
en.s: Henry David Thoreau (born David Henry Thoreau; July 12, 1817 – May 6, 1862) was an American naturalist, essayist, poet, and philosopher. A leading transcendentalist, he is best known for his book Walden, a reflection upon simple living in natural surroundings, and his essay "Civil Disobedience" (originally published as "Resistance to Civil Government"), an argument in favor of citizen disobedience against an unjust state.

zh.t: 美国超验主义哲学家亨利·戴维·梭罗出版回忆录《瓦尔登湖》
zh.s: 亨利·戴维·梭罗（原名戴维·亨利·梭罗；1817年7月12日—1862年5月6日）是美国博物学家、散文家、诗人和哲学家。他是超验主义的代表人物，以《瓦尔登湖》一书闻名，该书反思了在自然环境中简单生活；他还因散文《公民不服从》（最初以《抵抗公民政府》为题发表）而知名，文中主张公民不服从不公正的国家。

en.s: The Bombardment of Sveaborg, also known as the Battle of Sveaborg, took place on 9–11 August 1855, between Russian defenders and a joint British–French fleet during the Åland War, a Baltic Sea theater of the Crimean War. British and French ships bombarded the Russian fortress of Sveaborg from beyond the range of the defenders' artillery. After 48 hours of bombardment, the attackers withdrew without attempting a landing.

zh.s: 斯韦阿堡炮击又称斯韦阿堡战役，于1855年8月9日至11日发生。交战双方是俄军守军和英法联合舰队，属于奥兰战争的一部分；奥兰战争是克里米亚战争在波罗的海战区的战事。英国和法国军舰在守军炮火射程之外轰击俄军要塞。炮击持续48小时后，进攻方撤退，没有尝试登陆。

en.s: The Battle of Cedar Mountain, also known as Slaughter's Mountain or Cedar Run, took place on August 9, 1862, in Culpeper County, Virginia, as part of the American Civil War. Union forces under Maj. Gen. Nathaniel P. Banks attacked Confederate forces under Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson near Cedar Mountain as the Confederates marched on Culpeper Court House to forestall a Union advance into central Virginia. After nearly being driven from the field in the early part of the battle, a Confederate counterattack broke the Union lines resulting in a Confederate victory. The battle was the first combat of the Northern Virginia Campaign.

zh.s: 雪松山战役又称斯劳特山战役或雪松溪战役，于1862年8月9日在弗吉尼亚州卡尔佩珀县发生，是美国内战的一部分。纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯少将率领联邦军，在雪松山附近进攻托马斯·J·“石墙”杰克逊少将指挥的邦联军。当时邦联军正向卡尔佩珀法院镇推进，以阻止联邦军深入弗吉尼亚州中部。战役初期，邦联军一度几乎被赶出战场，随后发动反击，突破联邦军防线并获胜。这是北弗吉尼亚战役中的第一场战斗。

en.s: The First Battle of Donaldsonville took place on August 9, 1862, in Ascension Parish, Louisiana, as part of the Operations against Baton Rouge in the American Civil War. A number of incidents of artillery firing on Union steamers passing up and down the Mississippi River at Donaldsonville, Louisiana, influenced the U.S. Navy to undertake a retaliatory attack. Rear Adm. David G. Farragut sent the town notice of his intentions and suggested that the citizens send the women and children away. He then anchored in front of the town and fired upon it with guns and mortars.

zh.t: 唐纳森维尔第一次战役
zh.s: 唐纳森维尔第一次战役于1862年8月9日在路易斯安那州阿森松教区发生，是美国内战期间巴吞鲁日作战行动的一部分。此前，密西西比河唐纳森维尔附近多次发生炮击往来船只的事件，影响了美国海军，促使其发动报复性攻击。海军少将戴维·G·法拉格特通知镇民自己的行动意图，并建议他们让妇女和儿童离开。随后他将舰船停泊在镇前，用舰炮和迫击炮轰击该镇。

en.s: The Battle of the Badlands was fought in Dakota Territory, in what is now western North Dakota, between the United States army led by General Alfred Sully and the Lakota, Yanktonai, and the Dakota Indian tribes. The battle was fought August 7–9, 1864 between what are now Medora and Sentinel Butte, North Dakota. It was an extension of the conflict begun in the Dakota War of 1862.

zh.s: 荒地战役发生在达科他领地（今北达科他州西部），交战双方是阿尔弗雷德·萨利将军率领的美国陆军，以及拉科塔人、扬克托奈人和达科他部族。战斗于1864年8月7日至9日在今北达科他州梅多拉和森蒂内尔比尤特之间展开，是1862年达科他战争所引发冲突的延续。

en.s: The Battle of the Big Hole was fought in Montana, August 9–10, 1877, between the U.S. Army and the Nez Perce tribe of Native Americans during the Nez Perce War. Both sides suffered heavy casualties. The Nez Perce withdrew in good order from the battlefield and continued their long fighting retreat that would result in their attempt to reach Canada and asylum.

zh.s: 大洞战役于1877年8月9日至10日在蒙大拿州发生，交战双方是美国陆军和美洲原住民内兹珀斯部族，属于内兹珀斯战争的一部分。双方均伤亡惨重。内兹珀斯人有序撤出战场，继续长途撤退；他们后来试图前往加拿大寻求庇护。

en.s: The First Battle of Uruzgan took place in Uruzgan on August 9, 1892 between the Uruzgani Hazaras and the Emirate of Afghanistan during the Hazara Uprisings. After enduring a month-long siege, Faiz Mohammad Khan ultimately surrendered to the Hazaras. The Hazaras then took control of the fort, massacred the Afghan troops inside, and hunted down the remaining survivors.

zh.s: 乌鲁兹甘第一次战役于1892年8月9日在乌鲁兹甘发生，交战双方是哈扎拉人和阿富汗埃米尔国，属于哈扎拉起义的一部分。经历一个月的围城后，费兹·穆罕默德汗最终向哈扎拉人投降。哈扎拉人随后占领堡垒，屠杀了里面的阿富汗士兵，并追捕其余逃兵。

en.s: The International Congress of Mathematicians (ICM) is the largest conference for the topic of mathematics. It meets once every four years, hosted by the International Mathematical Union (IMU). The Fields Medals, the IMU Abacus Medal (known before 2022 as the Nevanlinna Prize), the Gauss Prize, the Leelavati Prize (since 2010) and the Chern Medal are awarded during the congress's opening ceremony.
en.n: The first International Congress of Mathematicians is held in Zürich, Switzerland.

zh.s: 国际数学家大会（ICM）是规模最大的数学会议，每四年举办一次，由国际数学联盟（IMU）主办。大会开幕式上会颁发菲尔兹奖、IMU阿巴库斯奖（2022年前称奈望林纳奖）、高斯奖、莱拉瓦蒂奖（2010年起）和陈省身奖。
zh.n: 首届国际数学家大会在瑞士苏黎世举行。

en.t: Coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra
en.s: The coronation of Edward VII and his wife, Alexandra, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions took place at Westminster Abbey, London, on 9 August 1902. Originally scheduled for 26 June of that year, the ceremony had been postponed at very short notice, because the King had been taken ill with an abdominal abscess that required immediate surgery.

zh.t: 爱德华七世与亚历山德拉加冕礼
zh.s: 1902年8月9日，爱德华七世与妻子亚历山德拉在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕，成为联合王国及大英自治领的国王和王后。仪式原定于当年6月26日举行，但国王突发腹部脓肿、需要立即手术，因此临时推迟。

en.s: The Battle of Bir el Abd or the Abd well (9 August 1916) was fought between the forces of the British Empire and the Ottoman Empire, during the Sinai and Palestine campaign of World War I. The battle took place in the Sinai Desert following the British victory at the Battle of Romani (3–5 August).

zh.s: 比尔阿卜德战役又称阿卜德水井战役，于1916年8月9日爆发。第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，大英帝国军队与奥斯曼帝国军队在西奈沙漠交战。此前，英军已在8月3日至5日的罗马尼战役中获胜。

en.s: At the beginning of August 1916, three French and one British division with 45,000 men and 400 guns launched an offensive against the Bulgarian positions at Doiran Lake, defended by the 2nd Thracian Infantry Division. The attack began on 9 August with heavy artillery fire on the positions of the 27th Chepino Regiment and 9th Plovdiv Regiment.

The Spanish suffered a major military defeat, which is almost always referred to by the Spanish as the Disaster of Annual (Spanish: Desastre de Annual) which is widely considered to be the worst defeat ever suffered by the modern Spanish Army.

en.s: The Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party (CPWDP), also known as the Peasants' and Workers' Party/PWP, is one of the eight minor non-oppositional political parties in the People's Republic of China, officially termed "democratic parties," led by the Chinese Communist Party. zh.t: 中国农工民主党于1930年8月9日在上海法租界正式成立
zh.s: 中国农工民主党（简称农工党）是中华人民共和国八个非反对党派的小党之一，官方统称“民主党派”，由中国共产党领导。1930年8月9日，该党由国民党左派人士在上海法租界正式成立。

en.s: The Birmingham Blitz was the heavy bombing by the Nazi German Luftwaffe of the city of Birmingham and surrounding towns in central England, beginning on 9 August 1940 as a fraction of the greater Blitz, which was part of the Battle of Britain; and ending on 23 April 1943. Situated in the Midlands, Birmingham, the most populous British city outside London, was considered an important industrial and manufacturing location.

zh.s: 伯明翰大轰炸是纳粹德国空军对英格兰中部伯明翰及周边城镇发动的猛烈轰炸，始于1940年8月9日，是更大范围空袭行动“闪电战”的一部分；“闪电战”又属于不列颠之战的一部分。轰炸于1943年4月23日结束。伯明翰位于英格兰中部地区，是伦敦以外英国人口最多的城市，也是一处重要的工业和制造业中心。

en.s: Operation Kosmaj, also known as the Blockade of Kosmaj or Operation Bader, was the first anti-guerrilla operation conducted by the Wehrmacht in occupied Serbia, aimed against the Yugoslav Partisans on Kosmaj mountain, near Belgrade. It took place from 7 to 9 August 1941, at the very beginning of the uprising in Serbia. The total number of German and Serbian troops engaged in the operation is roughly estimated between 3,000 and 8,000 soldiers and officers, supported by tanks.

zh.s: 科斯马伊行动又称科斯马伊封锁行动或巴德尔行动，是德军占领塞尔维亚后开展的首次反游击行动，目标是贝尔格莱德附近科斯马伊山上的南斯拉夫游击队。行动发生于1941年8月7日至9日，正值塞尔维亚起义初期。据粗略估计，约有3000至8000名德国和塞尔维亚士兵、军官参战，并有坦克支援。

en.s: The Death Match (Ukrainian: Матч смерті, Russian: Матч смерти) is a name given in postwar Soviet historiography to the football match played on 9 August 1942 in Kiev in Reichskommissariat Ukraine following the German invasion of the Soviet Union. The Kiev city team Start (Cyrillic: Старт), which represented the city's Bread Factory No. 1, played several football games in World War II.

zh.s: “死亡之战”（乌克兰语：Матч смерті；俄语：Матч смерти）是战后苏联史学为一场足球赛所起的名称。比赛于1942年8月9日在德国入侵苏联后、纳粹德国控制下的乌克兰帝国专员辖区首府基辅举行。基辅市队“开始队”（西里尔字母：Старт）代表市内的第一面包厂参赛，二战期间还参加过多场足球比赛。

en.s: The 1942 Cupa României final was the 9th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Universitatea Cluj-Sibiu and Rapid București, and was won by Rapid București after a game with 8 goals. It was the seventh cup for Rapid, and the sixth out of six consecutive successes.

en.s: The Battle of Savo Island, also known as the First Battle of Savo Island and in Japanese sources as the First Battle of the Solomon Sea (第一次ソロモン海戦, Dai-ichi-ji Soromon Kaisen), and colloquially among Allied Guadalcanal veterans as the Battle of the Five Sitting Ducks, was a naval battle during the Solomon Islands campaign of the Pacific War of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Navy and Allied naval forces.

zh.s: 萨沃岛海战又称第一次萨沃岛海战；日本资料称其为第一次所罗门海海战（日语：第一次ソロモン海戦，Dai-ichi-ji Soromon Kaisen）；参加瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役的盟军老兵则俗称其为“五艘活靶舰之战”。这场海战发生于第二次世界大战太平洋战争的所罗门群岛战役期间，交战双方是日本帝国海军与盟军海军。

It took place 7–9 August 1942 on the Solomon Islands, during the initial Allied landings in the Guadalcanal campaign. U.S. Marines of the 1st Marine Division, commanded by U.S.

en.s: The Battle for Hill 140 was fought on 9 August 1944 as part of Operation Totalize between a battle group from the 4th Canadian Division and German troops, mainly from the 12th SS Panzer Division "Hitlerjugend". en.s: The Soviet invasion of Manchuria, also known as the Manchurian Strategic Offensive Operation (Манчжурская стратегическая наступательная операция, lit. Manchzhurskaya Strategicheskaya Nastupatelnaya Operaciya) or simply the Manchurian Operation (Маньчжурская операция), began on 9 August 1945 with the Soviet invasion of the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo. It was the last campaign of the Second World War, and the largest of the 1945 Soviet–Japanese War which resumed hostilities between the Soviet Union and the Empire of Japan after almost six years of peace. Soviet gains on the continent were Manchukuo, Mengjiang (Inner Mongolia) and northern Korea.
en.n: The Australian War Memorial dates the Soviet invasion of Manchuria to 9 August 1945.

zh.s: 苏联入侵满洲又称“满洲战略进攻行动”（俄语：Манчжурская стратегическая наступательная операция，意为“满洲战略进攻行动”），简称“满洲行动”（俄语：Маньчжурская операция），于1945年8月9日开始，苏联由此入侵日本扶植的伪满洲国。这是第二次世界大战的最后一场战役，也是1945年苏日战争中规模最大的一场行动；苏日战争重燃了苏联与日本帝国近六年来的战火。苏联在亚洲大陆取得的领土包括伪满洲国、蒙疆（内蒙古）和朝鲜北部。
zh.n: 澳大利亚战争纪念馆将苏联入侵满洲的日期定为1945年8月9日。

en.t: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
en.s: On 6 and 9 August 1945, the United States detonated two atomic bombs over the Japanese cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, respectively, during the final days of World War II. en.s: The Battle of Nanpeng Island (Chinese: 南鵬島戰鬥) was fought between the Chinese Nationalists and the Chinese Communists. After Guangdong fell into communist hands, a detachment of the Nationalist troops held out on Nanpeng Island of Yangjiang. This remnant of the Nationalist forces proved to be a major headache the Communists because the island is strategically located between the Pearl River mouth and the Qiongzhou Strait, controlling the shipping line that was vital to the local economy. The Communists decided to rid of the Nationalist forces and take the island. In the morning of 9 August 1950, the third battalion of the 364th regiment of the 41st Army of the People's Liberation Army attacked the island.

zh.s: 南鹏岛战役（中文：南鵬島戰鬥）是中国国民党军与中国共产党军队之间的一场战斗。广东落入共产党手中后，一支国民党军残部坚守阳江南鹏岛。该岛位于珠江口与琼州海峡之间，战略位置重要，控制着对当地经济至关重要的航运线，因此这支部队令共产党方面十分头疼。共产党决定清除岛上的国民党军并夺取该岛。1950年8月9日上午，解放军第41军第364团第三营向该岛发起进攻。

en.t: On 9 August 1965, the Malaysian Parliament voted 126 to 0 to pass a constitutional amendment bill, thereby separating Singapore from Malaysia, which left Singapore as a newly independent country
en.s: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is an island country in Southeast Asia. Its territory comprises a main island, over 60 satellite islands and islets, and one outlying islet. The country is about one degree of latitude (137 kilometres or 85 miles) north of the equator, off the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula, bordering the Strait of Malacca to the west, the Singapore Strait to the south along with the Riau Islands in Indonesia, the South China Sea to the east and the Straits of Johor along with the State of Johor in Malaysia to the north.

zh.s: 新加坡，正式名称为新加坡共和国，是东南亚的岛国。其领土包括一个主岛、60多个附属岛屿和小岛，以及一座外围小岛。新加坡位于赤道以北约1度（137公里或85英里），在马来半岛南端外海；西邻马六甲海峡，南隔新加坡海峡与印度尼西亚廖内群岛相望，东临南中国海，北隔柔佛海峡与马来西亚柔佛州相邻。

en.s: Operation Demetrius was a British Army operation in Northern Ireland on 9–10 August 1971, during the Troubles. It involved the mass arrest and internment (imprisonment without trial) of people suspected of being involved with the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA), which was waging an armed campaign for a united Ireland against the British state. It was proposed by the Unionist government of Northern Ireland and approved by the British Government.

en.s: The Battle of Ventersdorp on 9 August 1991 was a violent confrontation in the South African town of Ventersdorp between right wing supporters of the Afrikaner Weerstandsbeweging (AWB) and the South African Police and security forces. Though technically not a "battle", it became known as such in the media while official sources such as the Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) simply refer to it as an "incident". Much of its notoriety lies in the fact that it was the first time in the 43 years of apartheid that police officers killed white protesters.

en.s: The Maxi Trial (Italian: Maxiprocesso) was a criminal trial against the Sicilian Mafia that took place in Palermo, Sicily. en.s: Aviateca Flight 901 was a scheduled international passenger flight which crashed into the 7,159-foot (2,182 m) San Vicente volcano in El Salvador of a Boeing 737-200 on approach to the Comalapa International Airport on 9 August 1995. The accident killed all 65 passengers and crew on board and is the deadliest aviation disaster to occur in El Salvador.

zh.s: Aviateca 901号航班是一班定期国际客运航班。1995年8月9日，一架波音737-200客机在飞往科马拉帕国际机场途中，撞上萨尔瓦多海拔7159英尺（2182米）的圣维森特火山。机上65名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。这是萨尔瓦多历史上最严重的航空事故。

en.s: Born to Be Wired was a professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on August 9, 1997. The event was held in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. Excerpts from Born to Be Wired aired on episodes #225 and #226 of the syndicated television program ECW Hardcore TV on August 12 and August 19, 1997, while the full event was released on VHS in 1997 and on DVD in 2002.

en.s: The 1997 Road Wild was the second Road Wild professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW) and the first to be produced under the Road Wild name. It took place on August 9, 1997 from the Sturgis Motorcycle Rally in Sturgis, South Dakota. zh.s: 1997年Road Wild是世界摔角冠军赛（WCW）制作的第二场Road Wild职业摔角按次付费赛事，也是首次以Road Wild之名举办的赛事。活动于1997年8月9日在南达科他州斯特吉斯的斯特吉斯摩托车集会上举行。主赛中，好莱坞·霍根击败莱克斯·卢格，夺得WCW世界重量级冠军。这是霍根连续第二年在该赛事中赢得冠军头衔。

en.s: Air Moorea Flight 1121 was a de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter which crashed into the ocean shortly after takeoff from Moorea Airport on Moorea Island in French Polynesia on 9 August 2007 killing all 20 people on board. It was bound for Tahiti's Faaʻa International Airport on a regular 7-minute service, one of the shortest in the world, scheduled 40 times a day.

zh.s: Air Moorea 1121号航班由一架德哈维兰加拿大DHC-6“双水獭”飞机执行。2007年8月9日，飞机从法属波利尼西亚莫雷阿岛的莫雷阿机场起飞后不久坠入海中，机上20人全部遇难。该航班原定飞往塔希提岛的法阿国际机场，是全程仅7分钟的定期航班，也是全球航程最短的航线之一，每天安排40班。

en.s: Bloodymania III was a professional wrestling event produced by Juggalo Championship Wrestling (JCW), which took place at midnight on August 9, 2009 at Hog Rock in Cave-In-Rock, Illinois. Professional wrestling is a type of sports entertainment in which theatrical events are combined with a competitive sport. The buildup to the matches and the scenarios that took place before, during, and after the event, were planned by JCW's script writers. Unlike the first two events, Bloodymania III did not feature a buildup from a season of JCW's SlamTV!

en.s: On 9 August 2013, four gunmen opened fire at a mosque in Quetta, Pakistan while people were exiting the mosque. As a result, at least ten people were killed and thirty more people were injured. en.s: Triplemanía XXIII was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) produced by the Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) promotion. It took place on August 9, 2015, at Arena Ciudad de México in Mexico City, Mexico. The event was the twenty-third year in a row that AAA has held a Triplemanía show, and was the thirtieth show held under the Triplemanía name since 1993 as AAA held multiple Triplemanía shows some years. The annual Triplemanía show is AAA's biggest show of the year, serving as the culmination of major storylines and feature wrestlers from all over the world competing in what has been described as AAA's version of WrestleMania or their Super Bowl event.

en.s: The CMLL Universal Amazons Championship (2019) (Spanish: Campeonato Universal de Amazonas) is a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament started on August 2, 2019, and ran for three Super Viernes shows with the final held on August 14, 2019, at Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. 2019 marked the first year that CMLL held a women's version of their annual Universal Championship tournament, with the intention to make the Universal Amazons Championship an annual event as well.

zh.s: CMLL女子环球冠军赛（西班牙语：Campeonato Universal de Amazonas）是墨西哥自由式摔跤联盟世界自由摔跤理事会（CMLL）举办并编排的职业摔跤锦标赛。赛事于2019年8月2日开赛，在三场“超级星期五”赛事中进行，决赛于8月14日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。2019年是CMLL首次举办女子版年度环球冠军赛，该联盟也计划将女子环球冠军赛办成年度赛事。

en.s: The 70th Anniversary Grand Prix (officially known as the Emirates Formula 1 70th Anniversary Grand Prix 2020) was a one-off Formula One motor race held on 9 August 2020 at the Silverstone Circuit in Silverstone, United Kingdom, the second of two back to back races at the venue, after the 2020 British Grand Prix seven days earlier. The race was the fifth round of the rescheduled 2020 Formula One World Championship.

zh.s: 70周年大奖赛的官方名称为“阿联酋航空一级方程式70周年大奖赛2020”，是一次性举办的一级方程式赛车比赛，于2020年8月9日在英国银石赛道举行。这是该赛道连续举办的两场比赛中的第二场，前一场是七天前举行的2020年英国大奖赛。该赛事是改期后的2020年一级方程式世界锦标赛第五站。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on Sunday, 9 August 2020. Early voting began on 4 August and ran until 8 August. Incumbent Alexander Lukashenko was announced by the Central Election Commission (CEC) to have won a sixth term in office, crediting him with just over 80% of the vote. Lukashenko has won every presidential election since 1994, with all but the first being labelled by international monitors as neither free nor fair.

zh.s: 白俄罗斯于2020年8月9日星期日举行总统选举。提前投票从8月4日持续至8月8日。中央选举委员会宣布，时任总统亚历山大·卢卡申科以略高于80%的得票率赢得第六个任期。卢卡申科自1994年以来赢得了每一届总统选举；国际观察员认为，除第一届以外的历次选举都既不自由也不公正。

en.t: The Tampere light rail officially starts operating
en.s: The Tampere light rail (Finnish: Tampereen raitiotie), branded as Tampere Tram (Finnish: Tampereen Ratikka), is a public transport system in Tampere, Finland. In November 2016, the Tampere city council approved plans to construct a 330-million-euro light rail system on the route from the city centre to Hervanta and to the Tampere University Hospital. Traffic on the first two lines of the route (lines 1 and 3) began on 9 August 2021.

zh.s: 坦佩雷轻轨是芬兰坦佩雷市的公共交通系统，芬兰语名称为Tampereen raitiotie，品牌名为坦佩雷有轨电车（Tampereen Ratikka）。2016年11月，坦佩雷市议会批准了建设轻轨系统的计划，项目预算为3.3亿欧元，线路从市中心通往赫尔万塔和坦佩雷大学医院。首期开通的1号线和3号线于2021年8月9日开始运营。

en.s: The 2022 Saky air base attack was an event during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, when several large explosions occurred at the Saky airbase in the town of Novofedorivka, Crimea, on 9 August 2022. The military base was seized by Russian forces during the 2014 annexation of Crimea, part of the Russo-Ukrainian War. The explosions destroyed a number of Russian warplanes and caused substantial other damage.

zh.s: 2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间，2022年8月9日，克里米亚新费多里夫卡镇的萨基空军基地发生多次大型爆炸。该军事基地在2014年克里米亚被俄罗斯吞并期间被俄军占领；此次吞并是俄乌战争的一部分。爆炸摧毁了多架俄罗斯军机，并造成其他重大损失。

en.s: General elections were held in Kenya on 9 August 2022. Voters elected the president, governors, senators, members of the National Assembly, and members of county assemblies. This was the third general election and the fourth presidential one since the promulgation of the 2010 constitution. Incumbent president Uhuru Kenyatta was not eligible for a third term according to the constitution, nor county governors who had served two terms.

zh.s: 肯尼亚于2022年8月9日举行大选，选民选举总统、郡长、参议员、国民议会议员和郡议会议员。这是2010年宪法颁布以来的第三次大选，也是第四次总统选举。根据宪法，时任总统乌胡鲁·肯雅塔不能竞选第三个任期；已任两届的郡长也不能参选。

en.s: The 2022 Minnesota's 1st congressional district special election was a special election held on August 9, 2022. The seat became vacant when incumbent Republican representative Jim Hagedorn died on February 17, 2022, from kidney cancer. A primary was held on May 24, 2022, with the special election being held eleven weeks later, on August 9, alongside state primaries for other races.

zh.t: 2022年明尼苏达州第1国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州第1国会选区于2022年8月9日举行特别选举，填补共和党籍众议员吉姆·哈格多恩于2022年2月17日因肾癌去世后留下的空缺。初选于2022年5月24日举行，11周后的8月9日举行特别选举；当天还同时举行了其他职位的州级初选。

en.s: The 2023 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira was the 45th edition of the Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira. It was played between the winners of the 2022–23 Primeira Liga, Benfica, and the winners of the 2022–23 Taça de Portugal, Porto, on 9 August 2023. Benfica won the match 2–0 to secure their 9th Supertaça title.

zh.t: 2023年坎迪多·德·奥利维拉超级杯
zh.s: 2023年坎迪多·德·奥利维拉超级杯是该项赛事的第45届，由2022—23赛季葡超冠军本菲卡对阵同赛季葡萄牙杯冠军波尔图，于2023年8月9日举行。本菲卡以2比0获胜，夺得队史第九座超级杯。

en.t: Football at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament final
en.s: The 2024 Summer Olympic football gold medal match was a football match to determine the gold medal winners of men's football tournament at the 2024 Summer Olympics. The match was the 26th final of the men's football tournament at the Olympics, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's under-23 national teams of the member associations of FIFA to decide the Olympic champions. The match was held at Parc des Princes in Paris, France, on 9 August 2024.

zh.t: 2024年夏季奥运会男子足球决赛
zh.s: 2024年夏季奥运会男子足球金牌赛决出了男子足球项目的金牌得主。这是奥运会男子足球赛的第26场决赛；该赛事每四年举行一次，由国际足联成员协会的23岁以下国家队争夺奥运冠军。比赛于2024年8月9日在法国巴黎王子公园球场举行。

en.s: Voepass Flight 2283 was a scheduled domestic Brazilian passenger flight from Cascavel to Guarulhos. On August 9, 2024, the ATR 72 serving the flight crashed in Vinhedo, São Paulo State. The aircraft was flying at an altitude of 17,000 ft (5,200 m) prior to stalling and entering a flat spin with a rapid descent at around 13:21 BRT. All 62 people on board died.

zh.s: Voepass 2283号航班是一班从卡斯卡韦尔飞往瓜鲁柳斯的巴西国内定期客运航班。2024年8月9日，执飞该航班的一架ATR 72飞机在圣保罗州维涅杜坠毁。飞机当时在1.7万英尺（5200米）高度飞行，随后失速、进入平螺旋并迅速下降，事故约于巴西利亚时间13时21分发生。机上62人全部遇难。

en.s: Israeli forces launched an incursion into Khan Yunis on 9 August 2024 as part of their invasion of the Gaza Strip during the Gaza war. zh.s: 2024年8月9日，以色列军队对汗尤尼斯发动地面突袭，这是其入侵加沙地带行动的一部分，发生于加沙战争期间。这是以军针对汗尤尼斯由哈马斯领导的巴勒斯坦武装力量发动的第三次独立地面行动，此前曾对该市实施首次围困，并进行过一次短暂突袭。

en.s: The 2025 Vietnamese Super Cup (Vietnamese: Siêu Cúp bóng đá Quốc gia 2025), also known as 2024–25 Vietnamese Super Cup - THACO Cup (Vietnamese: Siêu Cúp bóng đá Quốc gia 2024/25 – Cúp THACO) was the 26th Vietnamese Super Cup, an annual association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's V.League 1 and Vietnamese Cup competitions. zh.s: 2025年越南超级杯又称2024–25赛季越南超级杯——THACO杯（越南语：Siêu Cúp bóng đá Quốc gia 2025；Siêu Cúp bóng đá Quốc gia 2024/25 – Cúp THACO），是第26届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季越南甲级联赛和越南杯冠军参加。比赛于2025年8月9日在宁平的天长体育场举行，参赛双方为2024–25赛季越南甲级联赛冠军南定绿钢队和越南公安队（该赛季越南杯冠军）。

en.s: The 2025 Thai League Charity Match (Thai: ไทยลีก แชริตี้ แมตช์) was the inaugural edition of the fixture, introduced by the Football Association of Thailand (FA Thailand) as a new curtain-raiser for the domestic football season. Unlike its predecessors, the Kor Royal Cup and the Thailand Champions Cup, the Charity Match was established as an entirely new competition rather than a continuation or rebranding of earlier events. The match was played on 9 August 2025, contested between Uthai Thani, who had finished ninth in the 2024–25 Thai League 1, and Chonburi, the 2024–25 Thai League 2 champions, at the True BG Stadium in Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani.

zh.s: 2025年泰国联赛慈善赛（泰语：ไทยลีก แชริตี้ แมตช์）是首届赛事，由泰国足球协会推出，作为国内足球赛季的新揭幕战。与此前的皇家杯和泰国冠军杯不同，慈善赛是一项全新赛事，并非此前赛事的延续或更名。比赛于2025年8月9日在巴吞他尼府塔尼亚武里的True BG体育场举行，由2024–25赛季泰国足球甲级联赛第九名乌泰他尼对阵该赛季泰国足球乙级联赛冠军春武里。

en.t: Martha's Vineyard African American Film Festival
en.s: The Martha's Vineyard African American Film Festival is a film festival annually held in Oak Bluffs on Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, every August. It screens films with a curatorial focus on Black storytelling. In addition to films, the festival hosts panels like the Color of Conversations series and throws events such as the annual White Party, Director’s Brunch, the Black Excellence Brunch, and the Women's C-Suite lunches.
